title: ExplorationSettings
description: Data file content/world/exploration.json (B2-6 R14): how far an inhabitant sees the land. The core keeps the cells every inhabitant has seen; the player's view is the union of them and is never covered again. Seeing is a radius over the grid, wider when the inhabitant stands higher than its surroundings; nothing blocks the view (no line of sight against objects or hills). This range is its own value, not the perception radius of content/behaviour/utility.json (which things an inhabitant notices). Whole metres, so the core counts in cells without rounding. All numbers are placeholders until Marcel decides.

sight_range_m.description: How far an inhabitant sees the land on level ground, in metres.

SightHeightBonus.description: A view helps: an inhabitant that stands higher than the mean height of its surroundings sees further.

surroundings_radius_m.description: Radius in metres of the surroundings whose mean height the own height is compared with (water counts with its surface at sea level).

range_m_per_height_m.description: Metres of extra sight per metre the inhabitant stands above its surroundings; 0 = no bonus.

max_bonus_m.description: Most extra sight in metres, however high the inhabitant stands.
